第885章 为什么不离开（第1页）
所以很快，林熙便随汤奶奶一起去到了她家。
她们俩进门的时候，陈爷爷和陈万星还在对峙着。
爷孙俩一个坐在茶几左边，一个坐在沙发右边，而中间的茶几上则放着那辆小玩具车。
而两人的眼神都紧紧地锁在玩具车上，并且手也是蠢蠢欲动的。
看得出来一个想和玩具车玩，而另一个则拼命阻拦。
在开门声响起的时候，爷孙俩的注意力总算是从玩具车上转移了过来。
当看到林熙出现的那一刻，陈爷爷差点喜极而泣。
而一旁的陈万星对此则有些摸不着头脑，因为他并不清楚林熙的真实身份。
哪怕之前和奶奶在路上见到过林熙，他也没有过多在意，就只把她当做普通的街坊。
这会看到爷爷露出这么欣喜的表情，他只觉得很茫然。
而就在这时，茶几上的小玩具车突然动了起来，四个轮子快速转动着，朝着茶几边缘的方向驶去。
然后直接从茶几一跃而下，再顺着茶几驶进了沙发底。
陈万星看到这一幕，顿时瞪大了双眼。
经过一段时间的相处，陈万星和“豆子”早已成为了朋友，见他这么着急忙慌地钻进了沙发底下，不免担心起来。
而那边的汤奶奶和陈爷爷见状，大概也猜到了玩具车钻进沙发底下藏起来的原因。
毕竟天师这种职业，天生就是鬼怪的克星。
眼下这种情况，这小鬼可不得赶紧躲起来。

也就是现在门被他们堵住了，要不然汤奶奶都怀疑，这玩具车会不会直接擦着他们的脚边，从门口钻出去。
不过看到这玩具车对林熙这么畏惧，汤奶奶他们心中更添了几分安心。
这足以证明林熙的本领完全可以碾压对方，今天这鬼，他们赶定了！
林熙没有管汤奶奶一家三口在想什么，径直朝着沙发走去，然后指尖汇聚灵力，朝着沙发底下一指。
藏在沙发底下瑟瑟发抖的玩具车，就这么毫无抵抗力的飞出来了。
一旁的陈万星看到这一幕，眼睛顿时瞪得大大的，转头满脸震惊的看着林熙。
玩具车出来后，因为被林熙的灵力控制着，根本没办法再继续躲藏，只能在原地瑟瑟发抖。
林熙低头仔细看了一眼玩具车，很轻易便看到了蹲在玩具车旁边的透明鬼魂。
那是一个年纪和陈万星差不多的的小男孩。
看阴气和玩具车的损坏程度，应该去世了得有三五年了。
这去世的时间其实不算短，但也不算长。
看他这样子，这几年来，应该躲藏得比较好，没受什么委屈。
要是孤身一个小鬼在外面的话，其实还挺容易受到那些大鬼欺负的。
林熙大致看完这小鬼的情况后，便对他问道。
“你为什么要留在这里不离开，鬼和人不能长期共处，你应该知道吧。”

Chapter 885 Why not leave (Page 1)
So soon, Lin Xi went to Grandma Tang's house with her.
When they entered the door, Grandpa Chen and Chen Wanxing were still confronting each other.
The grandfather and grandson were sitting on the left side of the coffee table and the other on the right side of the sofa. On the coffee table in the middle was the small toy car.
Both of their eyes were locked on the toy car, and their hands were ready to move.
It was obvious that one wanted to play with the toy car, while the other tried his best to stop it.
When the door opened, the grandfather and grandson finally diverted their attention from the toy car.
Grandpa Chen almost cried with joy when he saw Lin Xi appear.
Chen Wanxing on the side was a little confused about this because he didn't know Lin Xi's true identity.
Even though he had seen Lin Xi on the road with his grandma before, he didn't pay much attention to her and just regarded her as an ordinary neighbor.
Seeing his grandfather showing such a happy expression, he just felt confused.
At this moment, the small toy car on the coffee table suddenly started to move, with its four wheels turning rapidly and heading towards the edge of the coffee table.
Then he jumped directly from the coffee table, and then drove along the coffee table and into the bottom of the sofa.
Chen Wanxing's eyes widened when he saw this scene.
After getting along for a period of time, Chen Wanxing and "Douzi" had already become friends. Seeing him hurriedly getting under the sofa, he couldn't help but worry.
Upon seeing this, Grandma Tang and Grandpa Chen over there probably guessed the reason why the toy car got under the sofa and hid it.
After all, a profession like Celestial Master is born to be the nemesis of ghosts and monsters.
In this situation, this kid had no choice but to hide quickly.
That is to say, the door is blocked by them now, otherwise Grandma Tang will doubt whether the toy car will directly rub their feet and get out of the door.
But seeing how afraid this toy car was of Lin Xi, Grandma Tang and the others felt even more at ease.
This is enough to prove that Lin Xi's ability can completely crush the opponent. They have defeated this ghost today!
Lin Xi didn't care what Grandma Tang and her family were thinking, and walked straight towards the sofa. Then she gathered spiritual power with her fingertips and pointed under the sofa.
The toy car that was hiding under the sofa flew out without any resistance.
Chen Wanxing's eyes widened when he saw this scene, and he turned to look at Lin Xi in shock.
After the toy car came out, because it was controlled by Lin Xi's spiritual power, it could no longer hide and could only tremble in place.
Lin Xi lowered her head and took a closer look at the toy car, and easily saw the transparent ghost squatting next to the toy car.
That was a little boy about the same age as Chen Wanxing.
Judging from the yin energy and the extent of the damage to the toy car, he must have been dead for three to five years.
The time of death is actually not short, but it is not too long either.
Looking at him like this, he must have been hiding better in the past few years and has not suffered any grievances.
If you are alone outside as a kid, you will actually be easily bullied by the big ghosts.
Lin Xi asked him after roughly reading the kid's situation.
"Why do you want to stay here and not leave? You should know that ghosts and humans can't coexist for a long time."
